How to read RTP and volatility

RTP. RTP (return to player) is the share of all money staked on a game that it pays back over millions of rounds, across all players. It does not predict what happens in your session.

Volatility. Volatility describes how wins are spread: low means frequent small wins, very high means long gaps and rare large wins. Higher volatility means your balance can drop faster.

Max win. Max win is the theoretical maximum of a single round, multiplied by your stake. It is very rarely reached.

  1. Low1 game
  2. Medium2 games

Questions before you join

Which Paper Lantern games does Marlowe Club have?

All six: Fox & Kite, Night Market, Moon Ferry, Ink & Gold, Lantern Festival and Paper Tigers.

Is the RTP the same at every casino?

Not always. Studios often offer several RTP versions and each casino picks one. We show the version Marlowe Club runs.

Can I play on my phone?

Yes. The games run in the mobile browser; no download is needed.

How do I deposit?

By card, bank transfer or e-wallet. You can set a deposit limit when you sign up.

Can I take a break?

Yes. Set time and loss limits in your account, or pause it for a period you choose.
